The free key's probe (run 4, 19:13Z) got HTTP 500 on all 12 REST paths ('No suitable host was found' / 'database system is shutting down'), and the socket handshake was refused with 403 for basketball, hockey and football. So I can't say whether the socket needs a paid plan or the URL is wrong. Next step: read Sportmicro's docs for the true base URL and socket address, re-run, and report.
